items.item_text: Experience as a Certified Nurse Assistant(CNA) at an accredited acute care hospital or health care facility
Minimum of three(3) months experience performing ADL’s(Activities of Daily Living) in a healthcare facility, including but not limited to home health, hospice, SNF, Rehab and acute care

Communicates, records, and reports promptly to the licensed nursing personnel vitals, treatment results, changes in patients condition, observations, patient complaints, and other pertinent information regarding the patient.
Checks and repositions all immobile and incontinent residents at a minimum of every two hours providing needed incontinent care promptly as required by assigned unit.
Promptly answers call lights and responds to alarms and patients requests.
Follow-up on patient care responsibilities and assignments left from previous shift and reports to team leader any incomplete assignments to ensure continuity of care.
Performs direct patient care activities for specific patient population according to established policies and procedures; adapts techniques to unique needs of each patient.
Accurately places electrodes and activates telemetry monitoring, as assigned. Respond to request for telemetry/lead troubleshooting whether that of assigned patient or not.
Successful completion of a California State approved Nursing Assistant program
